desc:
Welcome to Evolve a Pet! 🥚

How to Play:
🥚 Find and capture eggs
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
💰 Your pets earn you Cash
🐶 Level up and evolve your pets for even more Cash
🏋️ Lift weights to get strong enough for rarer eggs
🥷 Steal eggs from other players' bases
✨ Discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes, and mutations!

💤 Your pets keep earning Cash while you're offline!
♻️ Rebirth to multiply your earnings and reach new eggs!

👍 Like the game and join the group for a boost!
